mapper.select: SELECT b.*, p.name as passenger_name, p.email as passenger_email, p.phone as passenger_phone, f.base_fare, f.status as flight_status, pay.amount as payment_amount, pay.is_paid, pay.payment_method, t.ticket_id, t.fare as ticket_fare FROM bookings b JOIN passengers p ON b.passenger_id = p.passenger_id JOIN flights f ON b.flight_id = f.flight_id LEFT JOIN payments pay ON b.payment_id = pay.payment_id LEFT JOIN tickets t ON b.booking_id = t.booking_id WHERE b.booking_id = #{bookingId}
